If you are going to change device, please link your account beforehand.
You can continue to use and play with your game data by linking your account even after switching devices.

* Please note that linking your account will overwrite the game data on the linked device.
Previous save data cannot be retrieved if overwritten.

Blue Diamonds you purchased can be used across all devices linked to your account.
* They can be used even when linking across different platforms.
What should I do if I want to change phones?

Please use [Log in with Link ID], [Sign in with Apple], or [Sign in with Google].

[When linked with Link ID]
▼Instructions for the current device
1. Select [Dream Park] → [Menu] → [Other] → [Account] → [Set Link Password].
2.Enter a Link Password and select [OK].
3. Copy and make a note of the generated Link ID.

▼Instructions for the new device
1. Select [Title] → [Menu] → [Account Management] → [Log in with Link ID].
2. Enter a Link ID & Password and select [OK].


[When signed in with Apple]
▼Instructions for the current device
1. Go to [Dream Park] → [Menu] → [Other] → [Account] → [Sign in with Apple].
2. Sign-in with Apple ID and link account.

▼Instructions for the new device
1. Select [Title] → [Menu] → [Account Management] → [Sign in with Apple].
2. Sign-in with Apple ID.


[When signed in with Google]
▼Instructions for the current device
1. Go to [Dream Park] → [Menu] → [Other] → [Account] → [Sign in with Google].
2. Sign in with your Google account and link account.

▼Instructions for the new device
1. Select [Title] → [Menu] → [Account Management] → [Sign in with Google].
2. Sign in with your Google account.

After resetting, your previous Link settings will be discarded.

How do I unlink my accounts?

If you delete the app, your Login Data will be lost and you will no longer be able to continue playing.

If you haven’t linked your account, your game will start with a brand new account.
Before deleting the app, please link your account beforehand.

To avoid losing your Login Data, we recommend linking your account.
What if I delete (uninstall) the app from my device?

Once you have deleted your account, the account data is deleted from our game server.
Please read the Important Notes below regarding account deletion. 

[Important Notes]
・After account deletion, data cannot be restored.
・After account deletion, all save data will be lost and you will not be able to play the game with the same account again.
・After account deletion, unused Blue Diamonds will be lost.
・Please note that even by deleting your account, your subscription will renew automatically .
Please make sure to cancel your subscription on the platform where you purchased it.

You can delete your account by going to [Title] → Select [Menu] → [Delete Account].
Please tell me about deleting my account.
Blue Diamonds/Red Diamonds can be used on different platforms.
What happens to my Blue Diamonds/Red Diamonds if I link my accounts across different platforms?
Minigame Boosts are consumed at the Results menu. If you forcibly closed the app during a Minigame, the Minigame Boost will not be consumed.
If I forcibly closed the app during a Minigame, even if I don’t go back to the Minigame, will my Minigame Boost be consumed?

You can play Minigames with friends by creating a Room.

▼How to Create a Room
[Dream Park] → [Game] → [To Multiplayer] → [Play together (Talk to the holomem inside of Fortune Network)] → [Create Room].

After creating a Room and selecting a Minigame to play, the Room ID will be displayed.
The Room ID is required to join the Room, so please share it with your friends.
* Your friend must also have the Minigame unlocked or they will be unable to play.

▼How to Join a Room
[Dream Park] → [Game] → [To Multiplayer] → [Play together (Talk to the holomem inside of Fortune Network)] → [Join Room].
Can I play Minigames with friends?
Auto Live scores are calculated with a lower multiplier than when playing manually as Judgment Bonuses and Score Bonuses are not included.
Why is the score I earned in Auto Live lower than normal?

Some effects in a reduced/limited state.

▼Effects with reduced intensity
・Only activates when scoring a PERFECT
* This applies to AUTO too.

▼Effects with restricted usage
・Judgement Boost: It will not change from AUTO Judgement.
・Restore LIFE: LIFE will not be restored.

The above Skills with these effects will only activate [Score UP] effect when they are activated simultaneously.
Will Skills activate in Auto Live?

The higher the Unit Score, the bigger increase of Live score that can be earned.
You can increase your Unit Score by training holomem Members and Leaders of a Unit.

▼How to Train Lead holomem
You can train up Lead holomem by unlocking the Holomem Board.

■ Tile Types
・Leader Type (Red Tiles): Its effect can be used when assigned to a unit Leader.
・Member Type (Blue Tiles): Its effect can be used when assigned to a unit Member.
・Support Type (Yellow/Green Tiles): Even when not assigned to a unit it’s effect can be used.
・Connect Nodes: Connect effects activate when you place Members on Connect Tiles.

▼How to Train Members
・Level up Members to boost their individual parameters.

・When you Train a Member, the level cap increases.

・Use Bloom Pts to bloom Members and grants various effects.
*When you obtain the same member, you can earn Bloom Pts.
*Each Member can be Bloomed up to 5 stages.

・If a Member you own goes to Level 20 or higher, you are granted a bonus that is applied to your Unit Score as an Member Upgrade Bonus.
*A Member Upgrade Bonus is the total sum of all your Members’ bonuses. 
*The maximum Member Upgrade Bonus is 50%.
How can I improve my score?

When SLOW & FAST Display option is turned on and you mistime a Note tap, [SLOW] or [FAST] will be displayed.

The total number of SLOW & FAST is displayed on the Results screen.

You can turn SLOW & FAST Display ON & OFF by going to [Menu] → [Other] → [Live Config] → [Advanced] → [Display Guide] → [SLOW/FAST Display]
Can I tell if the tap timing is slow or fast?

This allows you to horizontally flip the position of the Notes and flick direction that appears during the Live.
Mirror Charts can be used on all Live.

Playing on Mirror Chart does not grant any special bonuses or rewards, and the score you earn will be the same as in the regular mode.
Also, if you achieve an ALL PERFECT or FULL COMBO, your results will be saved as they would be during regular play.

Other players are not notified when your Mirror Chart is ON during Multiplayer Live. 

You can turn Mirror Chart ON & OFF by going to [Menu] → [Other] → [Live Options] → [Live] → [Mirror Chart].
What’s Mirror Chart?
We handle inquiries and provide responses in Japanese for the Japanese version and in English for the global version.
What language should I send inquiries in?

To enjoy this game comfortably, we recommend playing within the recommended system requirements.
If your device does not meet the recommended requirements, some features or effects may not function properly, and you may not be able to enjoy smooth gameplay.
Please beware that if system requirements are not met, you may not be able to install the app or it will not perform correctly.

■System Requirements
▼iOS
Recommended OS： iOS 16 or higher
Recommended device: 6 GB of RAM or more (iPhone 14 and higher)

▼iPadOS
Recommended OS： iPadOS 16 or higher
Recommended device: 6 GB of RAM or more

▼Android
Recommended OS： Android11 or higher
Recommended device: 6 GB of RAM or more and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or higher CPU.

▼Steam
OS: Windows® 11 64-bit
Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 3500 / Intel® Core™ i5-9400
Memory: 8 GB
Graphics: Radeon™ RX 580 Graphics / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060

[Minimum System Requirements]
▼iOS
OS: iOS16 or more
Device: RAM 4GB or more (iPhone11 and upwards)

▼iPadOS
OS: iPadOS16 or more
Device: RAM 4GB or more

▼Android
OS： Android 11 or more
Device: RAM 4GB or more, Snapdragon 855 and upwards

▼Steam
OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i5-4430
Memory: 8 GB
Graphics: Radeon™ RX 370 Graphics / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 950

※The minimum system requirements are intended for launching the game and performing basic gameplay.
※They do not guarantee a smooth gameplay experience.
※The recommended and minimum system requirements may be changed in the future due to updates (Last update: July 2026)
What are the recommended system requirements?

If you are unable to update your app, please attempt the following:

[iOS Devices]
1. Open the App Store, and tap on [Today] at the lower part of the menu.
2. Tap on the profile icon on the top right of the Store menu.
3. Pull down menu labeled [Account]. 
4. Tap [Update All] displayed in either [Available Updates] or [Upcoming Automatic Updates], or tap the [Update] button by [hololive Dreams].
* If you have enabled automatic download in your device settings, [Available Updates] will be displayed as [Updates coming soon]. 

[Android Devices]
▼Check the download manager app is set to "Enabled".
1. Open the [Settings] menu on you device.
2. Select [Apps] or [App Manager].
3. Swipe to view all apps.
4. Select the Download Manager app.
If [Enable] is displayed, then Download Manager is disabled. Tap to [Enable].

▼Choose [Clear Data] and [Clear Cache].
Please delete each the relevant options in the Download Manager app.
*Please try [Delete Cache] in your device settings, not inside the app.
* Please note that [Delete Data] does not mean to delete (uninstall) the app itself.

▼Clear the cache and data from the Google Play Store.
1. Tap [Google Play Store] inside the app.
2. Tap [Clear Data] and [Clear Cache].
* Please note that [Delete Data] does not mean to delete (uninstall) the app itself.
* Please note that the menu titles may vary depending on the device you are using.

Can I play the game with an emulator?

Blue Diamonds can be obtained by purchasing Diamonds or certain paid items.
Red Diamonds can be obtained through login bonuses, live clear rewards, and achievement rewards.

You can check how many Blue/Red Diamonds you own in the top-right corner of the Shop and Gacha menu.
When you use Diamonds and you have both Blue/Red Diamonds, Red Diamonds will be used first.
* Some Gacha and items can only be used with Blue Diamonds.

You can possess up to 1,000,000 Blue Diamonds.
You can’t purchase Blue Diamonds if the total would exceed the maximum limit.
There is no inventory limit for Red Diamonds.
What are Blue/Red Diamonds?

It may take some time for Blue Diamonds to appear in your account after purchase.
Try restarting the app to resolve the issue.

If the situation is not resolved after following the steps above, please contact us via [Purchase Item] in [Contact Us].

You can cancel your Membership and HoloPassport subscriptions by following the steps below.

[iOS Devices]
1. Select your Player Name from [Settings].
2. Select [Subscription].
3. Select [hololive Dreams] subscription.
4. Select [Cancel Subscription] to end subscription.

[AndroidDevices]
1. Select Player Icon in Google Play Store.
2. Select [Payments & Subscriptions].
3. Select [Subscriptions].
4. Select [hololive Dreams].
5. Select [Cancel Subscription].

▼Important Notes
・If you have any concerns about the cancellation procedure, please contact your platform provider.
・Please note that deleting the app or save data will not cancel your subscription. Please be careful.
・If you wish to cancel, please do so 3 days (72 hours) before the automatic renewal date.
* If it’s within 3 days (72 hours) of the automatic renewal, the platform may not be able to cancel the subscription within the deadline.
・Even if the subscription is canceled during the valid period, you can continue to use the corresponding services until the subcription period ends.
How do I cancel a Membership or HoloPassport?

A Login Bonus is sent to your Gifts by logging in once a day.
You can claim the Login Bonus sent to Gifts by following the steps below.

▼Claim Instructions
[Dream Park] → [Menu] → [Gifts] → [Deliveries]
* If you have already received it, it will appear in Gift History.
I didn't receive a Login Bonus.

You can possess up to 999,999,999.
Any excess items will be sent to the gift box.
Is there a limit to amount of coins and items you can possess?

Gift History will show up to the last 100 entries.
Older entries will be deleted when exceeding 100.
I can no longer see Gift History.

Gifts may have deadline to claim them.
Please check the Gift menu for each Gift claim deadline.
Gifts that are expired will be deleted, so please claim them as soon as possible.

If the system is running slowly, experiencing long load times, or otherwise behaving unstably, this could be caused by a number of factors.

Please check that your system meets the recommended system requirements.
* If your system does not meet the recommended system specifications, the game is not supported. Please consider using a system that meets the recommended system specifications.

■System Requirements
▼iOS
Recommended OS： iOS 16 or higher
Recommended device: 6 GB of RAM or more (iPhone 14 and higher)

▼iPadOS
Recommended OS： iPadOS 16 or higher
Recommended device: 6 GB of RAM or more

▼Android

Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 3500 / Intel® Core™ i5-9400

If your system meets the recommended system requirements and the issues persists, please try the following:

■Steps to Follow
・Use in a location with a stable connection.
・Close and reopen the app.
・Restart your device.
・Please check your device's available storage space.
* If you are running out of storage space on your device, please free up some space and restarting it.

If the above does not resolve your issue, please contact us with the details.
A communication error has occured and is causing the app to freeze (stalls/crashes).

If an error occurs while while using the Gacha or when the animation plays, you will still obtain the Member.

Please check the corresponding Gacha’s Gacha Log to see which Member you obtained.

■How to check Gacha Log
1. Select Gacha.
2. Select the Gacha where issue occurred.
3. Select Gacha Log.

* In Gacha, if you earn a Member you already own, they will be converted into Bloom Pts.
You can check the number of Bloom Pts you have on the Bloom menu of the relevant Member.
The game crashed while I was in the middle of Gacha. How do I obtain Members?

Link your account to share your save game data between multiple devices.
If the device already contains save data, you share to overwrite current save data.

※ Please beware that previous save data cannot be retrieved if overwritten when the account has not been linked.
Account Link

Complete Achievements to earn Holomem Rank EXP, Titles, Red Diamonds and other rewards.

Please note that playing in Auto Live, Created Charts, or Private Rooms may not count toward Achievement requirements.
The following Achievements are not included.

▼Auto Live
・Number of completed Live/Number of Songs
・Number of FULL COMBO/ALL PERFECT/Number of Songs

▼Original Chart
・Achievements unrelated to Live Show Clears and Original Charts.

▼Private Room
Achievements linked to rankings and results in live shows and mini-games

Example:
・Number of MVP in Live Together
・1st Place in Mega Circuit
・1st Place in Pokajan!
・Number of "3 same-color cards" hand in Pokajan!.
・Number of times being Pokajan!

Achievements menu can be viewed by going to [Dream Park] → [Achievements]
Achievements

You can check which Members you own in the Members List.

Select a Member to view their level, type, parameters, skills, etc.
There are three types of parameters; [Performance], [Technique], and [Sense], which affects Unit Score.
There are three types; [Cute], [Pure] & [Happy], which affects Skill Effects & Skill Activations.

For ★5 Members, you can toggle to display  their autographs and messages on the member details screen.

You can view the Members List by going to [Park] → [Menu] → [Members].
About Members

Each member possesses three of the following skills.

▼Member skills
・Special Skill: A powerful skill that can activated once during a Live (order of activation is determined by formation order)
・Active Skill: A skill that activates randomly during Live at a certain intervals.
・Passive Skill: A skill that constantly provides an effect if conditions are met.

Bloom members to level up skill effects.
Skills

There are different skill effects.

▼Skill Effect
・Score Up Increases the score you earn while in effect.
Score Support Increases the score you earn while in effect.
・Judgement Boost GOOD and GREAT becomes PERFECT while in effect.
・Restore LIFE: Restores LIFE for a fixed amount.
・Skill Activation Rate UP: Skill activation rate increases while in effect.
・Parameter boost: the related parameter is boosted.
About Skill Effects

You can consume Lesson Pts to level up Members.
Leveling up a Member increases their parameters.
Leveling Up

The Member Upgrade Bonus is a bonus applied to your Unit Score during Live.
If a Member you own goes to Level 20 or higher, you are granted a bonus, the higher the level, the greater the bonus.
A Member Upgrade Bonus is the total sum of all your Members’ bonuses. 
* The maximum Member Upgrade Bonus is 50%.
Member Upgrade Bonuses

When you Train a Member, the level cap increases.
Items needed for training can be obtained from Live and Holowork.
Training

Each Member can consume Bloom Pts and be Bloomed up to 5 stages.
Use Bloom Pts to Bloom Members and grant various effects.

Bloom Pts exist for each member and they can be used for their corresponding Member to Bloom them.
When there is a duplicate Member, you can obtain Bloom Pts for that Member.

★5 Members can Bloom using a “Bloom Stone”.
Bloom Stones can be obtained at the Special Holosticker exchange in the shop.
Blooming

In the holomem List, you can check each holomem's unlock stats.
Selecting a unlocked holomem allows you to view various information such as their Holomem Rank, Holomem Board and Outfits.

The holomem menu can be viewed by going to [Park] → [Menu] → [holomem]
holomem

Collect Holomem Rank EXP to increase your Holomem Rank.
Holomem Rank EXP can be obtained by hitting corresponding holomem's achievements.
When a Holomem Rank increases, you can obtain Holomem Board Points and park outfits.
Holomem Rank

By unlocking Tiles on the Holomem Board for each holomem, you can gain many kinds of effects during Live & Minigames.

▼ Tile Types
・Leader Type (Red Tiles): Its effect can be used when assigned to a unit Leader.
・Member Type (Blue Tiles): Its effect can be used when assigned to a unit Member.
・Support Type (Yellow/Green Tiles): Even when not assigned to a unit it’s effect can be used.
・Connect Nodes: Connect effects activate when you place Members on Connect Tiles.

Required materials to unlock Nodes can be earned through holomem's achievements and Exchanges.
Holomem Board

You can combine Songs to create Charts.
You can even create your own charts and publish them, or play with other player-generated charts.
Creating Charts

You can play your in-progress Chart by tapping [▶ PLAY].
You can play it by [moving play bar], [move the Chart] and [not scrolling].

Also, you can tap [l◀] to play from the beginning, tap the yellow flag symbol to start playing from a specified place (cue) in the Chart.
You can set cues by double tapping on the right side of the editor where the Notes numbers are displayed.
Chart Creation [Play Settings]

You can insert Chart templates of officially prepared Charts or one’s you’ve created yourself.

You can register up to 30 custom templates you’ve created for Charts.
You can register a Note by selecting it with the Select Tool and choosing [Make Template] from the Options menu.

You can also paste various Templates or delete Custom Templates by long pushing on the Editor menu.
Chart Creation [Templates]

By long-pressing the Editor menu and adjusting the Note speed multiplier, you can change the speed of Notes in a specific range of the Chart.

For example, it is possible to temporarily slow it down or to make it appear as if the Chart has momentarily stopped.
Chart Creation [Notes Speed Multiplier]

By selecting the gear icon, you can adjust detailed settings while creating a Chart.

▼Music Volume
You can adjust the music volume on the create menu.

▼Note Sound Effect Volume
You can adjust the volume of the Sound Effects when notes are placed.

▼Note Height
You can adjust the Note height on the create menu.

▼Decorative Note Frame Display
You can configure the frame display setting for decorative Notes on the create menu.

▼Display Chart Reference
If there is a Chart you are using as a reference, you can turn referring display to ON/OFF.
By turning this ON, the Chart from you are referencing will be displayed faintly in the center of the create menu.

▼Autosave
You can set autosave to ON/OFF on the create menu.
*Please note that autosave will not be performed if the Chart cannot be saved or published, such as when no Notes have been placed.

▼BGM
You can set the dedicated BGM to ON/OFF in the create menu.
Chart Creation [Other Settings]

You can Play Test by tapping [▶ PLAY].
In Play Test, you can select either Manual Play or Auto-Play.
You can also play the Song from the beginning or from a specified cue position.
Chart Creation [Play Test]

You can save and publish Charts you’ve created from [File].
Please note that saving will not publish your creation.
When publishing, you can set Titles, Thumbnail, Chart difficultly level and more.
Keep in mind that it may take some time for your published chart to appear in the New and Popular lists.

▼Titles
You can attach Titles to Charts you’ve created.

▼Difficulty Level
You can set the difficulty level of Charts.

▼Thumbnails
You can set a thumbail for the Chart by taking an image of a section.

▼Tags
You can set two tags from the following: [Beginner], [Advanced], [Classic], [Funny], [Drawing], or [Challengers Wanted]

▼Types
The type is automatically set when there are Damage Notes, or when three or more Notes need to be pressed simultaneously.

▼Play Visibility
You can set the ability to play created Charts to either be [Public (All)], [Friends], [People Who Know the Chart ID], or [Private].

▼Chart Referencing
You can set the ability to reference created Charts to either be [Public (All)], [Friends], [People Who Know the Chart ID], or [Private].
Chart Creation [Publishing]

To play another player’s Chart, select [CREATE] for any Song on the Solo Live selection screen, or choose a Created Chart by tapping the [▶ Play] button on the Live Portal menu.

* In Created Charts, no Live Boosts are used, nor can Completion Rewards and EXP earned.
How to Play

There are three methods to make a Chart in Create Charts.

▼Use Official Chart as Reference
Create a Chart by choosing the Song and Chart difficulty and referencing officially published Charts.

▼Create From Scratch
Choose a song and create from scratch.

▼Use Player Chart as Reference
You can create new Charts by referencing other player-created ones.
* You can select from Charts that approve of referencing.
Chart Creation

Choose the type of Note and tap where you want to place it.

▼A warning message will be displayed in the following cases:
・When certain Notes are partially overlapping.
・When 128 or more, 256 or fewer Notes are placed within a certain measure.
・When there are simultaneous presses of 3 or more Notes.
※Even if one of these warning message is displayed, you can still save and publish:

▼Notes cannot be placed in the following cases.
・When the Total Combo count exceeds 9999
・When more than 256 Notes are placed within a single measure.

▼If one of these warning messages is displayed, you will be unable to test the chart or publish:
・When no Notes are placed.
・When there are simultaneous presses of 6 or more Notes.
・When certain types of Notes are completely overlapping.
・When a Damage Note completely covers a Judgment Note or an ongoing Long Note.
・When the Total Combo count exceeds 9999
・When more than 256 Notes are placed within a single measure
Chart Creation [Editor]

▼Select Tool
With the Select Tool selected, tapping on a Note in Editor will select it.
When you select a Note, you can make various changes from the Options menu.
* For details, please go to [Chart Creation [Options]]

You can change the width of a selected Note from the arrow next to the Note.
You can select multiple Notes.

Additionally, while the Select Tool is active, tapping the Select Tool icon again switches to Range Selection mode.

▼Eraser Tool
With the Eraser Tool selected, you can select and delete Notes in Editor.
Chart Creation [Select Tool & Eraser Tool]

▼Regular Notes
You can position regular Notes.

▼Accent Notes
You can place yellow accent notes that produce a different tap sound and are more likely to result in PERFECTs.

When an Accent Note is selected, tap a placed Note to change it into an Accent Note. Tap an Accent Note to change it back into a regular Note.
You can also tap a Long Note to change it into an Accent Long Note, and tap an Accent Long Note to change it back into a Long Note.
But there’s more! Tap a Flick Note to change it into an Accent Flick Note, and tap an Accent Flick Note to change it back into a Flick Note.

▼Flick Notes
You can position Flick Notes.

When a Flick Note is selected, tap a placed Note to change it into a Flick Note. Tap a Flick Note to change it back into a regular Note.
You can also tap the end of a Long Note to change it into a Flick Note. Tap the end of a Long Note with a Flick Note to change it back to a normal Long Note.
But there’s more! Tap an Accent Note to change it into an Accent Flick Note, and tap an Accent Flick Note to change it back into an Accent Note.

▼Long Notes
You can position Long Notes.
* For details, please go to [Chart Creation [Long Notes & Mid Notes ]]

▼Mid Notes
You can position Mid Notes between the start and end points of Long Notes.
* For details, please go to [Chart Creation [Long Notes & Mid Notes ]]

▼Decoration Notes
You can position Decoration Notes that don't need to be tapped because of their appearance.
You can position them like Long Notes.
Additionally, you can change the color of Decoration Notes.

▼Damage Notes
You can place Damage Notes that interupt your combo and reduce your LIFE when touched.
Chart Creation [Different Notes]

When you select a Note with the Select Tool, the Options will be displayed.
You can change the angle of Long Notes by choosing [Straight], [Curve 1] or [Curve 2].

Also, when you select a Mid Note Long Note with the Select Tool, you can change the type of Mid Note to the following.

▼Regular
The Note will appear and when tapping correctly and increasing a combo, a SFX will play and a hit effect will appear.
If you place it in the middle of a Long Note, the Long Note will pass through it.

▼Not Visible 
Notes will not appear nor count towards combos, etc.
If you place it in the middle of a Long Note, the Long Note will pass through it.
You can draw complex curves and shapes without triggering SFX or increasing combos.

▼Ignore
The Note will appear and when tapping correctly and increasing a combo, a SFX will play and a hit effect will appear.
However, even if you place it in the middle of a Long Note, the Long Note will not pass through it.
You can position Mid Notes without changing the Long Notes angle, etc.
Chart Creation [Long Notes & Mid Notes ]

You can open the Note Options by selecting a Note with the Select Tool.
You can copy and paste Notes in the Options.
You can also register multiple selected notes as a Template, flip them horizontally or vertically.

You can copy and paste the Notes you've selected by long-pressing the Editor as either normal or inversed.
Chart Creation [Options]

▼Estimated Difficulty
A estimated difficulty level will be displayed based on the density of Notes.
Any estimated difficulty level of 30 or higher is expressed as “Lv30+”.
For reference, the creator set the Chart level when saving.

▼Statistics 
Tap the[i] button next to Estimated Difficulty to display statistics of the in-creation Chart.
You can check the number of placed Notes in your Chart and total combo count.
Furthermore, you can view the layout of all of the Notes in the Chart from full-screen view.

Notes are the icons that travel down the lanes during a Live.
The Notes travel down the lane and you are judged on your timing and action when they overlap at the hit lane.

There are different types of judgment; PERFECT, GREAT, GOOD, BAD and MISS, which affect your score and combo.
GREAT and above will increase your combo, whereas GOOD, BAD and MISS will break it.
BAD and MISS will result in losing LIFE.

There the primary types of Notes.

▼Blue Regular Notes
Tap in time with the moment they go over the line.

▼Pink Flick Notes
Flick in time.
If multiple Flick notes come at the same time, you can continue flicking without lifting your finger.

▼Green Long Notes
Keep holding from start to finish and trace the direction.
*There is no penalty even if you don’t release at the exact timing at the end of a Long note.
*During long notes, you can briefly lift your finger without breaking the hold, allowing you to switch to another finger for slide patterns and similar notes.

▼Yellow Accent Notes
Notes with different tap sounds. More likely to achieve PERFECTs.

▼Gray Notes
If you select the Rhythm Support option in Live Options, Regular Notes will turn gray during upbeats and similar sections, making timing mismatches easier to understand.
Notes・Scoring

LIFE is points that are necessary to continue Live.

▼Retire
The Live ends.
* You will not receive rewards.

▼Retry
You begin the Live from the start.

▼Continue
Your LIFE will be fully recovered, and the Live will resume.
Please note that this will cost 20 Diamonds to resume.
LIFE
